name: o11
tagline: One wallet for agents to access paid goods and services ("OpenRouter for agent goods and services")
status_notes: PIVOT: YC W26 company originally launched as an AI agent inside Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace for finance teams (YC launch post still shows this). As of 2026-10-27 the site, YC profile one-liner and docs describe an agent wallet / paid-tool gateway: prepaid USD wallet, 'cards' (agent allowances), MCP/CLI/TS SDK/HTTP, ~8.4K tools. Very early: client v0.1.9 (checksum-verified tarball; npm latest still 0.1.4, 'npm publication pending'), YC team size 2. o11's own comparison posts (Oct 18 2026) say their evidence is a 'local implementation and audit', 'card funding is disabled in the inspected local configuration', and the /v1/purchase (goods checkout) endpoint says 'Card issuing is stubbed: no order or payment is submitted'. Every public tool contract is marked verification=captured_contract_only, liveAccountChecked=false. Catalog is aggregated: of 8,172 public contracts, 3,949 are sourced from Treg's GitHub catalog (superdesigndev/treg, a listed competitor), 1,463 from AgentMuxer, 2,760 o11-authored. Separate older product line 'o11 retention' (@o11/retention-cli) still exists.
backers: Y Combinator (W26; homepage banner: 'new funding led by Y Combinator')

catalog.notes: Homepage claim. Public contract index (catalogSha256 5c6f0296...) lists toolCount 8,172 with ~550 provider slugs; by source: treg 3,949 / o11 2,760 / agentmuxer 1,463. Largest providers: tikhub 1,900 (23%), dataforseo 458, anyapi 397, justoneapi 272, api-strale-io 197, x 173, scrapecreators 172, defillama 135, replicate 133. Homepage samples: OpenAI 8, Anthropic 1, Exa 15, Firecrawl 16, ElevenLabs 11, Replicate 133, Perplexity 8, Resend 1.

pricing.notes: YC profile: 'o11 has zero markup'. Tool contracts say 'No o11 service fee' / 'No o11 markup' and price at supplier PAYG rate (e.g. Adyntel page = 12,800 micros = $0.0128). No public pricing page (/pricing 404). Prepaid wallet credits; customer-mode (BYO account) calls do not debit o11 credits. Docs: 'Failed work can still incur supplier fees'; uncertain outcomes keep the hold until reconciled. First wallet of a new workspace 'can include a small free credit' (amount unpublished). Money in integer USD micros. subscription=false means no o11 subscription documented.

payment_rails: prepaid fiat (USD) wallet credits via in-app Billing (payment method not publicly documented)
BYO provider account (customer mode, billed by provider)
upstream x402/USDC settlement by o11 on caller's behalf for some AgentMuxer-sourced suppliers (agent never holds crypto)
goods purchase API (US/USD) - card issuing stubbed

access.cli_package: @o11/sdk (commands o11-wallet, alias o11); installed via `curl -fsSL https://docs.o11.ai/downloads/install-wallet.ts | bun -` (v0.1.9); npm has only 0.1.4

spend_controls.notes: Card = per-agent allowance (e.g. monthly), allowed tools/services, allowed connected accounts, max spend per call, write and recurring-purchase permissions. Budgets can be shared or nested (ancestor budgets); server-side reservation before dispatch; per-invoke maxCostMicros hard ceiling. awaiting_approval / request_manager_review states. Keys: replace/revoke, tool-only delegated keys, OAuth tokens 1h renewable up to 30 days. A key can't raise its own allowance.

setup_steps_to_first_call: Run installer: curl -fsSL https://docs.o11.ai/downloads/install-wallet.ts | bun - (checksum-verified, private dir)
o11-wallet --profile NAME login --server https://go.o11.ai (email + 6-digit code in terminal, or Google)
Approve recommended access in browser Connect page (new account auto-gets wallet + 'Universal Card')
o11-wallet --profile NAME setup (verifies access, MCP bridge, cards without spending)
Add funds in Billing if balance is zero (small free credit may exist on first wallet)
o11-wallet invoke --input request.json (toolId, idempotencyKey, maxCostMicros) -> wait INVOCATION_ID
Alt: remote MCP client adds https://go.o11.ai/mcp, completes OAuth, calls cards/discover/quote/invoke (no CLI or key copy)

public_endpoints_probed.notes: WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="https://go.o11.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp", scope="wallet:tools offline_access"; body {"error":"UNAUTHORIZED","message":"Connect your agent to continue"}
No persistent GET event stream per docs
Catalog search requires card bearer key
resource https://go.o11.ai/mcp; auth server https://go.o11.ai; scopes wallet:tools, offline_access
authorize/token/register (dynamic client registration)/device_authorization endpoints under https://go.o11.ai/oauth/*

PUBLIC unauthenticated catalog: 2.37 MB JSON, CORS *, toolCount 8172, each entry links to a per-tool contract JSON (request schema, auth templates, capturedPrice, source, verification). Mirror at https://docs.o11.ai/tool-reference/index.json (200).
Sample contract: source treg (superdesigndev/treg adyntel.yaml), capturedPrice 12800 micros, 'No o11 service fee', verification captured_contract_only
OpenAPI 3.1, 35 POST /v1/* operations, cardKey bearer security; no unauthenticated operations

strengths: Zero markup claimed; per-tool contracts state supplier PAYG rate and 'No o11 service fee'
Strong spend-control model: per-agent cards, tool allowlists, nested/shared budgets, per-call hard ceiling, server-side reservations, approval states, write/recurring consent flags
Quote -> invoke -> receipt lifecycle with idempotency keys, run IDs for task cost roll-up, cancel, history, disputes/feedback API
Both wallet-funded and BYO provider accounts per call (explicit credentialMode, no silent fallback)
Every transport: remote MCP with OAuth (DCR + device flow), stdio MCP via CLI, TS SDK, plain HTTP, skill.md, llms.txt, OpenAPI 3.1
Public unauthenticated contract index for ~8.2K tools (useful for benchmarking catalog breadth)
Bridges x402-only suppliers behind a fiat wallet (o11 handles the 402 challenge, caps at caller max)
Very agent-oriented, detailed skill.md guidance for recovery and budget handling
weaknesses: Very early: client 0.1.x, npm publish pending (npm latest 0.1.4 vs docs 0.1.9), 2-person team, CLI requires Bun

Catalog breadth largely aggregated from others: ~48% of public contracts sourced from Treg's GitHub catalog (whose license restricts hosted third-party use without written permission; o11's authorization status unknown), ~18% from AgentMuxer; 23% is one provider (TikHub)
Every contract is 'captured_contract_only'; o11's own blogs say evidence is local/offline and card funding was disabled in the inspected configuration; most output schemas not captured
No public pricing page, free credit amount unpublished, funding methods not documented
No unauthenticated catalog search API or MCP tools/list; discovery requires account + OAuth
Failed calls can still incur supplier fees
Brand confusion with prior M365/finance AI product and o11 retention CLI sharing the `o11` command
